nodes.label: Competitor analysis
nodes.rationale: Include 'do nothing / spreadsheet' as baseline; end with defensible wedge.

nodes.label: Go-to-market
nodes.rationale: Focus one primary acquisition channel first.

nodes.label: Lean Canvas
nodes.rationale: Preferred over full Business Model Canvas because faster to iterate.

nodes.label: TAM/SAM/SOM market sizing (top-down + bottom-up)
nodes.rationale: Flag when top-down and bottom-up estimates disagree; never invent numbers.

nodes.label: Unit economics (CAC, ARPU, LTV:CAC, payback)
nodes.rationale: Build bottom-up from unit economics rather than top-down.

nodes.label: product-stack Skill
nodes.rationale: Default conventions; existing consistent project patterns take precedence over this file.

nodes.label: Isolate flaky integrations (rate limits, partial failures)
nodes.norm_label: isolate flaky integrations (rate limits, partial failures)

nodes.label: Supabase Row Level Security on every table
nodes.norm_label: supabase row level security on every table
nodes.rationale: Never disable RLS even temporarily to get it working.

nodes.label: Tailwind design tokens over arbitrary values
nodes.norm_label: tailwind design tokens over arbitrary values
nodes.rationale: Arbitrary values signal a missing token; avoid @apply since it hides utilities from tooling.

nodes.label: Run tsc --noEmit / next build before done
nodes.norm_label: run tsc --noemit / next build before done

nodes.label: Zod validation at boundaries
nodes.rationale: Don't trust third-party TypeScript types as runtime truth.

nodes.label: App Router + Server Components by default
nodes.norm_label: app router + server components by default
nodes.rationale: Keep 'use client' small and low in the tree; fetch data server-side.

nodes.label: Core Web Vitals budget (LCP<2.5s, CLS<0.1, INP<200ms)
nodes.norm_label: core web vitals budget (lcp<2.5s, cls<0.1, inp<200ms)

nodes.label: Playwright E2E testing
nodes.rationale: Test user-visible behavior, golden path plus 1-2 realistic edge cases.

nodes.label: Measure production build, not dev mode
nodes.norm_label: measure production build, not dev mode

nodes.label: Security review delegated to security-review skill
nodes.norm_label: security review delegated to security-review skill
nodes.rationale: Avoid duplicating security checks already handled by security-review / Security Guidance plugin.

nodes.label: Stack: Next.js + TypeScript + Tailwind + Supabase + Stripe
nodes.norm_label: stack: next.js + typescript + tailwind + supabase + stripe

nodes.label: Recommended Marketplace Plugins
nodes.rationale: Not bundled in repo; installed from knowledge-work-plugins marketplace if useful.

nodes.label: Server Actions / Route Handlers split
nodes.rationale: Server Actions for form mutations; Route Handlers for webhooks and third-party callbacks.

nodes.label: Service-role client only in trusted server contexts
nodes.norm_label: service-role client only in trusted server contexts

nodes.label: Stripe webhooks as source of truth (signature-verified, idempotent)
nodes.norm_label: stripe webhooks as source of truth (signature-verified, idempotent)
nodes.rationale: Stripe can retry or deliver out of order; client redirect result is not trustworthy.

nodes.label: Riskiest assumption test
nodes.rationale: Usually 'will anyone pay', not 'can we build it'.

nodes.label: Generated Supabase types (single source of truth)
nodes.norm_label: generated supabase types (single source of truth)

nodes.label: Migrations as files (supabase/migrations)
nodes.rationale: Reproducible schema changes instead of dashboard edits.
